title: Lavender
body:
"Lavender is a fragrant herb with purple flowers, commonly used in aromatherapy and cooking."

Description

The Lavender are sellable common flowers, that can be found in the Ferwater regions. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 75$ per Lavender. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~2.86% per flower.
